description:
### Release v3.16.7

- **Fix Gboard 18.5.4 Coexistence Conflict & Package Rename**: Fixed an issue where Gboard 18.5.4 failed to rename `androidx-startup` ContentProvider authorities (`com.google.android.inputmethod.latin.androidx-startup` and `com.google.android.inputmethod.latin.train.androidx-startup`), which caused system installer conflicts with official Google Gboard (`INSTALL_FAILED_CONFLICTING_PROVIDER`).
- **Seamless Multi-Version Coexistence**: 18.0.3, 18.5.4 Beta, and official Google Gboard can now be installed side-by-side with complete stability.
